Reads an agent_feed (AGF-*) from CAS and writes
`.zqk/agent-runtime/agent_chat_channel.json`

(enabled, delivery_mode, feed_id, contract_schema_version, path overrides, probe
filters).

Ensures the events JSONL parent directory exists.



Prefer rematerializing from a live AGF after object updates instead of
hand-editing the lite file.

  Materialize lite policy from a live agent_feed
  zqk.test system materialize-agent-chat-channel --feed-id AGF-001
  Preview without writing
  zqk.test system materialize-agent-chat-channel --feed-id AGF-001 --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk.test system materialize-agent-chat-channel [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run            Print materialized lite JSON without writing
      --feed-id string     agent_feed object id (AGF-*)
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
